title: Stage-0 crypto harnesses charge the 7.5 bps default, not the measured Bybit linear 11.0: route their fee through roundtrip_fee_bps_for
note: Follow-up of COST-STACK-BYBIT-TAKER-FEE (PR #20783, which makes profile_loader.roundtrip_fee_bps_for return 11.0 for bybit:linear). These harnesses take execution_costs.DEFAULT_FEE_BPS_ROUNDTRIP directly and never call the resolver, so every crypto Stage-0 corpus still charges 7.5 bps RT: scripts/backtest_trend.py:113, backtest_pullback.py:94, backtest_ict_scalp.py:78 (+CLI help :1344), backtest_squeeze.py:55, backtest_fade.py:72, backtest_chop_scalp.py:59, backtest_xsec_momentum.py:100, src/backtest/run_backtest_vwap.py:96, scripts/research/pullback_frac_cross_leg_sweep.py:66/155/380, scripts/research/exit_head_final_fold_replay.py:86; scripts/ops/build_strategy_evidence.py takes fee_bps_roundtrip from each harness bt.json (line 538), so it inherits. Fix: resolve fee per symbol via resolve_cost_policy-style helper (unset => venue fee, explicit CLI value wins, explicit 0.0 stays the fee-only arm). Observation that closes it: re-run of a crypto leg harness prints fee_bps_roundtrip 11.0 in its bt.json; re-cost impact is already tabulated in comms/research/desk_edge/levers/bybit-fee-recost-impact-2026-10-28.json (one flip: ict_scalp_eth_15m). Not started; harnesses' PnL series move, so re-baseline evidence records after.
